requirements.meaning: Top-down 2D exploration perspective in a fantasy setting
requirements.verification: Player moves freely in 2D top-down directions.

requirements.source: in one connected world where a lush enchanted forest surrounds a frozen lake and icy ruins
requirements.meaning: All regions exist together in a single open area
requirements.verification: Verify all regions are visible in the same scene view.

requirements.source: walk naturally from the green forest into the snowy region without changing levels
requirements.meaning: Seamless transition between biome regions without loading screens or separate levels
requirements.verification: Player walks continuously from green tiles to snow tiles without scene reloads.

requirements.source: The frozen lake has slippery terrain
requirements.meaning: Physics modifier affecting movement momentum on the frozen lake surface
requirements.verification: Player sliding momentum increases when walking on the frozen lake region.

requirements.source: A forest villager asks me to retrieve a magical crystal from the icy ruins
requirements.meaning: Quest delivery loop involving dialogue and item retrieval
requirements.verification: Interacting with the villager initiates a quest, and collecting the crystal completes the objective.

requirements.source: focused on exploration with no combat
requirements.meaning: Exclusion of enemies, fighting systems, and health bars
requirements.verification: Ensure no enemies exist and player cannot attack.

scope: Structured construction witnesses plus specific runtime checks; visual style needs human review.
